accessibleDescription.description:
Defines the accessible description of the component.

**Note:** Available since [v2.14.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.14.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

accessibleDescriptionRef.description:
Receives id(or many ids) of the elements that describe the input.

**Note:** Available since [v2.14.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.14.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

accessibleName.description:
Defines the aria-label attribute for the component.

**Note:** Available since [v2.1.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.1.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

accessibleNameRef.description:
Receives id (or many ids) of the elements that label the component.

**Note:** Available since [v2.1.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.1.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

className.description:
CSS Class Name which will be appended to the most outer element of a component.
Use this prop carefully, overwriting CSS rules might break the component.

disabled.description: Defines the disabled state of the comonent.

displayFormat.description:
Determines the format, displayed in the input field.

**Note:** Available since [v2.21.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.21.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

formatPattern.description:
Determines the format, displayed in the input field.

Example:
HH:mm:ss -> 11:42:35
hh:mm:ss a -> 2:23:15 PM
mm:ss -> 12:04 (only minutes and seconds)

name.description:
Determines the name by which the component will be identified upon submission in an HTML form.

**Note:** This property is only applicable within the context of an HTML Form element.

**Note:** Available since [v2.0.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.0.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

onChange.description:
Fired when the input operation has finished by clicking the "OK" button or
when the text in the input field has changed and the focus leaves the input field.

| cancelable | bubbles |
| :--------: | :-----: |
| ❌|✅|

onClose.description:
Fired after the value-help dialog of the component is closed.

**Note:** Available since [v2.0.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.0.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

| cancelable | bubbles |
| :--------: | :-----: |
| ❌|✅|

onInput.description:
Fired when the value of the `TimePicker` is changed at each key stroke.

| cancelable | bubbles |
| :--------: | :-----: |
| ❌|✅|

onOpen.description:
Fired after the value-help dialog of the component is opened.

**Note:** Available since [v2.0.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.0.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

| cancelable | bubbles |
| :--------: | :-----: |
| ❌|✅|

open.description:
Defines the open or closed state of the popover.

**Note:** Available since [v2.0.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.0.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

placeholder.description:
Defines a short hint, intended to aid the user with data entry when the
component has no value.

**Note:** When no placeholder is set, the format pattern is displayed as a placeholder.
Passing an empty string as the value of this property will make the component appear empty - without placeholder or format pattern.

readonly.description: Defines the readonly state of the comonent.

required.description:
Defines whether the component is required.

**Note:** Available since [v2.1.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.1.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

style.description:
Element style which will be appended to the most outer element of a component.
Use this prop carefully, some css properties might break the component.

valueFormat.description:
Determines the format, used for the value attribute.

**Note:** Available since [v2.21.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.21.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

valueState.description: Defines the value state of the component.

valueStateMessage.description:
Defines the value state message that will be displayed as pop up under the `TimePicker`.

**Note:** If not specified, a default text (in the respective language) will be displayed.

**Note:** The `valueStateMessage` would be displayed,
when the `TimePicker` is in `Information`, `Critical` or `Negative` value state.

__Note:__ The content of the prop will be rendered into a [<slot>](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/slot) by assigning the respective [slot](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/slot) attribute (`slot="valueStateMessage"`).
Since you can't change the DOM order of slots when declaring them within a prop, it might prove beneficial to manually mount them as part of the component's children, especially when facing problems with the reading order of screen readers.

__Note:__ When passing a custom React component to this prop, you have to make sure your component reads the `slot` prop and appends it to the most outer element of your component.
Learn more about it [here](https://ui5.github.io/webcomponents-react/v2/?path=/docs/knowledge-base-handling-slots--docs).

__Supported Node Type/s:__ `Array<HTMLElement>`
valueStateMessage.x-typescriptType: false | ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReducedReactNode> | ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Array<InternalUI5WCSlotsNode>

waitForDefine.description:
Defines whether the component should wait for the underlying custom element of the web component to be defined. This can be useful, for example, for using instance methods when mounting the component.

__Note:__ This adds a rendering cycle to your component.
